formula:
let acc = this.annual_report(fiscal_year: fiscal_year) in
this.fact_in(concept: concept, unit: unit, accession: acc, period_end: {host}/relay/sec.gov/filing/period_end(accession: acc), period_kind: period_kind)

otherwise(this.reported(concept: "us-gaap:Revenues", unit: "USD", fiscal_year: fiscal_year, period_kind: "annual"),
 otherwise(this.reported(concept: "us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax", unit: "USD", fiscal_year: fiscal_year, period_kind: "annual"),
 otherwise(this.reported(concept: "us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerIncludingAssessedTax", unit: "USD", fiscal_year: fiscal_year, period_kind: "annual"),
 otherwise(this.reported(concept: "us-gaap:SalesRevenueNet", unit: "USD", fiscal_year: fiscal_year, period_kind: "annual"),
 otherwise(this.reported(concept: "us-gaap:SalesRevenueGoodsNet", unit: "USD", fiscal_year: fiscal_year, period_kind: "annual"),
 otherwise(this.reported(concept: "us-gaap:SalesRevenueServicesNet", unit: "USD", fiscal_year: fiscal_year, period_kind: "annual"),
 this.reported(concept: "us-gaap:RevenuesNetOfInterestExpense", unit: "USD", fiscal_year: fiscal_year, period_kind: "annual")))))))

otherwise(this.reported(concept: "us-gaap:CostOfRevenue", unit: "USD", fiscal_year: fiscal_year, period_kind: "annual"),
 this.reported(concept: "us-gaap:CostOfGoodsAndServicesSold", unit: "USD", fiscal_year: fiscal_year, period_kind: "annual"))

otherwise(this.reported(concept: "us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss", unit: "USD", fiscal_year: fiscal_year, period_kind: "annual"),
 this.reported(concept: "us-gaap:ProfitLoss", unit: "USD", fiscal_year: fiscal_year, period_kind: "annual"))
this.reported(concept: "us-gaap:OperatingIncomeLoss", unit: "USD", fiscal_year: fiscal_year, period_kind: "annual")
this.reported(concept: "us-gaap:Assets", unit: "USD", fiscal_year: fiscal_year, period_kind: "instant")
this.reported(concept: "us-gaap:AssetsCurrent", unit: "USD", fiscal_year: fiscal_year, period_kind: "instant")
this.reported(concept: "us-gaap:LiabilitiesCurrent", unit: "USD", fiscal_year: fiscal_year, period_kind: "instant")
this.reported(concept: "us-gaap:InventoryNet", unit: "USD", fiscal_year: fiscal_year, period_kind: "instant")
this.reported(concept: "us-gaap:PropertyPlantAndEquipmentNet", unit: "USD", fiscal_year: fiscal_year, period_kind: "instant")
this.reported(concept: "us-gaap:AccountsPayableCurrent", unit: "USD", fiscal_year: fiscal_year, period_kind: "instant")
this.reported(concept: "us-gaap:AccountsReceivableNetCurrent", unit: "USD", fiscal_year: fiscal_year, period_kind: "instant")
this.current_assets(fiscal_year: fiscal_year) / this.current_liabilities(fiscal_year: fiscal_year)
this.net_income(fiscal_year: fiscal_year) / ((this.total_assets(fiscal_year: fiscal_year) + this.total_assets(fiscal_year: fiscal_year - 1)) / 2) * 100 percent
this.cost_of_revenue(fiscal_year: fiscal_year) / ((this.inventory(fiscal_year: fiscal_year) + this.inventory(fiscal_year: fiscal_year - 1)) / 2)
this.revenue(fiscal_year: fiscal_year) / ((this.ppe_net(fiscal_year: fiscal_year) + this.ppe_net(fiscal_year: fiscal_year - 1)) / 2)
((this.accounts_payable(fiscal_year: fiscal_year) + this.accounts_payable(fiscal_year: fiscal_year - 1)) / 2) / this.cost_of_revenue(fiscal_year: fiscal_year) * 365 d

((this.inventory(fiscal_year: fiscal_year) + this.inventory(fiscal_year: fiscal_year - 1)) / 2) / this.cost_of_revenue(fiscal_year: fiscal_year) * 365 d
 + ((this.accounts_receivable(fiscal_year: fiscal_year) + this.accounts_receivable(fiscal_year: fiscal_year - 1)) / 2) / this.revenue(fiscal_year: fiscal_year) * 365 d
 - ((this.accounts_payable(fiscal_year: fiscal_year) + this.accounts_payable(fiscal_year: fiscal_year - 1)) / 2) / this.cost_of_revenue(fiscal_year: fiscal_year) * 365 d
(this.revenue(fiscal_year: fiscal_year) - this.cost_of_revenue(fiscal_year: fiscal_year)) / this.revenue(fiscal_year: fiscal_year) * 100 percent
(this.revenue(fiscal_year: fiscal_year) - this.revenue(fiscal_year: fiscal_year - 1)) / abs(this.revenue(fiscal_year: fiscal_year - 1)) * 100 percent
